platforms.name: Fresh On The Net Weekly Send Us A Track Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / global independent-artist discovery platform
platforms.feeAmount: Free public submission route. The inbox opens Monday morning and closes after 200 tracks or by Wednesday evening, whichever comes first.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official inbox was closed when verified. A human must wait for an authorized open window, inspect the live form and any runtime controls, confirm the selected track is publicly streamable in full worldwide, has not been submitted before, is not a remix or alternate version of a previously submitted track, and is not AI-generated.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from the official Send Us A Track page. Fresh On The Net accepts one track per artist per week, closes at 200 submissions or Wednesday evening, rejects private or territory-restricted tracks and explicitly rejects AI-generated music. The site showed current Listening Post and Alt Picks activity through July 10, 2026. No form was opened or submitted and the secondary Exile FM email route was not used to bypass the primary FOTN-first requirement.

platforms.name: KFAI Music Department and Music Library Email Route
platforms.country: United States / Minneapolis-Saint Paul community radio with global eclectic programming
platforms.feeAmount: Free public music-sharing contact route; no payment requirement was stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KFAI publishes a purpose-specific Music Department and Music Library email link, but the address is protected in the retrieved page and was not decoded. A human must use the official contact page, review the final pitch and authorized assets, and accept that the station may not confirm receipt because of submission volume.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from KFAI's official contact page and current homepage. The station explicitly invites artists to share their music with the Music Department and Music Library. Current activity includes July/August 2026 Aircheck content, programs recorded and posted in July 2026, and Disco Never Died Day programming on July 12, 2026. The adjacent newsletter honeypot was excluded from the music route. No protected address was decoded and no email was sent.

platforms.name: WMNF Music Department Upload Form and Music Relations Email Route
platforms.country: United States / Tampa community radio with broad music programming
platforms.feeAmount: Free official submission route; no payment requirement was stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The form requires artist identity, location and contact details plus one or more music files. A human must confirm rights, file selection, metadata and consent before upload, inspect the live form for runtime controls, and decide whether to use the form or the separately published musicrelations@wmnf.org address without sending duplicate submissions.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from WMNF's official Submit Music page. The form accepts MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, AIFF, WMA and M4A files, up to five files and 50 MB each, and WMNF states that its Music Department may forward suitable music to show hosts or add it to the Hot Box. The official page also publishes musicrelations@wmnf.org for all music emails. WMNF showed current music and station content through July 11, 2026. No upload, form submission, email, cookie acceptance or Cloudflare-protected action occurred.
